data.name: Ammadis
data.gender_notes: Ammadis is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'amados' meaning 'beloved', and 'dis' meaning 'god'. The name Ammadis is a combination of 'Ammas' (father of) and 'Dis' (god), creating a name that signifies a father of the divine or a godfather. This name is commonly used in Christian communities as a name for a devout and faithful man. The name Ammadis carries the meaning “Father of the faithful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ammadis usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine paternity and spiritual guidance.
data.etymology: Ammadis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of the faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ammadis total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אממדיס
in_hebrew.meaning: אממדיס - שמו של ישוע המשיח אהוב ונאמן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אממדיס הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הארמית והוא נמצא בשימוש גם בעברית. משמעותו היא 'אממד' שפירושו 'מהימן' או 'נאמן', ו-'יס' שהוא סיומת שמות נפש. השם מורכב מיסודות שמקורם בתנ"ך ומשקפים את התכונות הרצויות לאדם מאמין. השימוש בשם זה משקף את הערכה של הנוצרים לאמון ולנאמנות בישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Αμμάδις
in_greek.meaning: Αμμάδις - όνομα του Κυρίου μας Ιησού Χριστού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αμμάδις έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρamaϊκή γλώσσα και χρησιμοποιείται επίσης στην ελληνική γλώσσα. Η λέξη 'Αμμάδ' σημαίνει 'πιστός' ή 'αξιόπιστος', ενώ η κατάληξη '-ις' είναι συνηθισμένη σε αρσενικά ονόματα. Το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά τις ιδιότητες που επιθυμούνται σε έναν πιστό Χριστιανό, δηλαδή την πίστη και την αξιοπιστία. Η χρήση του ονόματος αυτού αποτελεί ένδειξη σεβασμού και εκτίμησης για την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Ιησού Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Ammadis
in_latin.meaning: Ammadis - nomen Domini nostri Jesu Christi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ammadis originem habet in lingua aramaica et etiam in Latino usu est. 'Ammad' significat 'fidelis' vel 'dignus fide', et '-is' est terminus nominis masculini. Hoc nomen proprietates reflectit quae in fideli Christiano desiderantur, scilicet fides et fidelitas. Usus huius nominis est significatio reverentiae et aestimationis pro fide et devotionem ad Jesum Christum.

in_english.name: Ammadis
in_english.meaning: Ammadis - a devoted and faithful follower of Jesus Christ
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ammadis originates from Aramaic and reflects the profound spiritual significance of devotion and faithfulness. Derived from 'Ammad,' meaning 'faithful' or 'trustworthy,' and the suffix '-is,' denoting a masculine name, Ammadis embodies the virtues highly esteemed in Christian tradition. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to signify a strong bond with God and adherence to Christian values. The name symbolizes a deep commitment to spiritual beliefs and practices, resonating with the core principles of Christianity. In contemporary usage, Ammadis continues to inspire as a symbol of unwavering faith and loyalty to Jesus Christ.
